system: Worldshepherd QRF External Evidence Partner Target Matrix
volatility: current-access and product claims must be re-verified before outreach, purchase, or test execution
selection_policy: Rank by shortest defensible path to a specific QRF campaign gate, evidence quality, integration relevance, and current access/partner signal. Scores are internal fit scores, not probabilities of agreement.

targets.current_use: first real-QPU evidence path for QRF-BELL-001
facts: IBM Quantum Platform documents an Open Plan with free QPU access up to 10 minutes per rolling 28-day window.
Current Qiskit Runtime service authentication uses the ibm_quantum_platform path and an API key; an instance is recommended but not always required by current clients.
RuntimeJobV2 metrics expose created/running/finished timestamps and QPU usage details suitable for retained queue/latency provenance.
targets.next_action: Use an actual IBM Quantum account/instance, inject IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN at runtime, declare the real plan name and recorded job cost, then execute scripts/run_ibm_qpu_bell.py. Never commit the token.

facts: Q-CTRL states that Ironstone Opal has been validated in airborne, ground, and maritime trials.

Q-CTRL explicitly states it is engaging select partners for additional field trials and system-integration demonstrations.

targets.current_use: parallel APNT magnetic-navigation partner and comparator path
facts: SandboxAQ describes AQNav as an APNT magnetic navigation system using high-sensitivity quantum sensors, AI, and Earth's magnetic field.
Its current AQNav product page reports testing across more than 200 sorties and more than 500 flight hours.
SandboxAQ announced participation in DIU's Transition of Quantum Sensing program for magnetic navigation defense use cases.
targets.next_action: Request a technical evaluation path that can produce a calibration identity, truth-reference dataset, uncertainty characterization, interface definition, and repeatable denied-GNSS test evidence compatible with WS-APNT campaign records.

targets.product_or_capability: precision atomic clocks, inertial sensors, gravimetry and PNT
targets.current_use: field-validated atomic sensing/timing alternative for APNT
facts: IonQ completed its acquisition of Vector Atomic on October 7, 2025.
IonQ states that the acquired portfolio includes precision atomic clocks, inertial sensors and synchronization hardware for space, submarine and airborne applications.
IonQ describes Vector Atomic sensing systems as field-deployed or field-validated across demanding environments.
targets.next_action: Route APNT outreach through IonQ/Vector Atomic as a precision timing/inertial sensing integration request with calibration, truth-reference and denied-GNSS test requirements defined up front.

targets.product_or_capability: quantum inertial sensing, quantum clocks and navigation solutions
targets.current_use: parallel inertial-sensing and timing path for APNT
facts: Infleqtion describes quantum inertial sensing for long-duration GPS-independent navigation and other PNT-relevant use cases.
Infleqtion's current corporate materials list quantum clocks and inertial navigation solutions in its commercial portfolio.
targets.next_action: Request a bounded evaluation focused on calibrated inertial/timing outputs, uncertainty, interface data and availability of a test dataset or live-device integration path.

claim_control: This matrix is current partner/access intelligence, not proof of availability to Worldshepherd, not an endorsement, and not evidence that any campaign gate has been satisfied. Every external fact must be re-verified at execution time and every resulting artifact must pass QRF structural and technical evidence review.
